comment: The note correctly explains that one platform may realise several elements and one element may be distributed across several systems. However, this distinction appears late and is essential to interpreting the two-layer architecture and component catalogue.

public.text: The note correctly explains that one platform may realise several elements and one element may be distributed across several systems. However, this distinction appears late and is essential to interpreting the two-layer architecture and component catalogue.
public.suggestedRevision: Move this explanation to Section 2.1 or repeat it prominently when the two-layer model is first introduced. Include it in the procurement guidance to prevent one-component-one-product interpretations.
